effort_estimate.assumption: Estimates cover reading evidence, applying rubric fields, and notes. They are planning estimates, not performance claims.

quality_controls.enforcement: Reviewers who miss calibration sentinels are retrained before receiving benchmark rows.

quality_controls.threshold: 2 independent reviews for every pilot, expansion, and source-acquisition candidate before promotion
quality_controls.enforcement: Single-reviewed rows remain in preflight queues and cannot be promoted.

quality_controls.threshold: required citation ids must exist and support the final label, not only a nearby fact
quality_controls.enforcement: Citation id, label, answer, and insufficiency/conflict mismatches go to adjudication or repair.

quality_controls.threshold: 100% of disagreements plus any invalid/calibration-failed reviewer batch
quality_controls.enforcement: Adjudication readiness must be regenerated before release after returned labels are imported.

quality_controls.threshold: agreement claims require completed reviewer pairs and non-null agreement metrics
quality_controls.enforcement: The paper must report unavailable agreement as unavailable while reviewer pairs are incomplete.
